notes: CBER letter (no CGMP inspection findings cited) charging that Interfyl®, a decellularized human placental connective tissue matrix product, is an unapproved new drug and unlicensed biological product because it fails the HCT/P homologous-use criterion and is promoted for non-homologous orthopedic uses. FDA did inspect the facility, but the letter's violations rest entirely on the product's regulatory classification/marketing claims, not on manufacturing/CGMP deficiencies, so no CGMP-related categories apply. No FEI or organisms are stated.
